description:
Workspace canonical-template propagation follow-up to bd:JMAP-qz9v.29 (contacts-server, closed now).

The 'Sentinel fields the backend MUST replace' rustdoc subsection on create_object trait method is canonical-pattern infrastructure in jmap-mail-server (the workspace canonical). Audit at HEAD:

| Sibling | Has `Sentinel fields` doc on create_object |
|---|---|
| jmap-mail-server | YES (canonical) |
| jmap-chat-server | yes |
| jmap-calendars-server | yes |
| jmap-contacts-server | YES (just landed) |
| jmap-tasks-server | NO |
| jmap-metadata-server | NO |
| jmap-sharing-server | NO |
| jmap-filenode-server | NO |

PROPAGATE: port the section to the four siblings that lack it. Canonical text at crate-jmap-mail-server/src/backend.rs:64-87 plus the just-landed contacts-server adaptation at crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/backend.rs:42-79.

Per-sibling adaptations:
- **tasks-server**: TaskList / Task / TaskNotification — sentinels likely match contacts (just `id` = "placeholder"). Verify against handler call sites (`grep -n placeholder crate-jmap-tasks-server/src/`).
- **metadata-server**: Metadata / Annotation — sentinels likely match. Verify same way.
- **sharing-server**: Principal / ShareNotification — likely just `id` = "placeholder". Verify.
- **filenode-server**: FileNode — likely has `id` = "placeholder" AND potentially `blob_id` = "placeholder-blob" matching the Email mail-server analog. Verify.

For each sibling: the doc text mirrors contacts-server (or mail-server when there are blob_id sentinels). The list of sentinels MUST match the handler's actual or_insert_with(Value::String(...)) calls — do not document sentinels that don't exist; do not omit sentinels that do.

Pure-rustdoc change, no code. P3 because failure mode is backend-implementor reads incomplete trait doc and ships a record reachable by the real id but carrying `id == "placeholder"` in its serialized form — a class of bug a careful reader of the existing handler source would catch, but the trait doc shouldn't depend on careful reading.

Cross-reference: bd:JMAP-qz9v.29 (contacts close), bd:JMAP-qz9v.13 (the handler-side placeholder mechanic that this trait-level contract supports).
title: Propagate 'Sentinel fields the backend MUST replace' rustdoc to tasks/metadata/sharing/filenode backend traits
